Partly. The tool found no tree-cover loss event of 0.5 ha or more inside the asset (ASSET-D, 311.2 ha) between 2021 and 2025. Hansen data had full valid coverage, and the JRC map shows about 285.6 ha (91.8% of the asset) as forest in 2020.

This is not proof of "intact." The check cannot rule out smaller changes: anything under 0.5 ha, at edges, or narrower than the 30 m pixels may be missed. It also says nothing about gradual degradation outside what this method detects, about anything before 2021 or after 2025, or about regulatory compliance (for example EUDR status).

A fair statement is: "No tree-cover loss of 0.5 ha or more was detected after the 2020 baseline through 2025." Note that the MGAP 2021 source was unavailable, though the two sources used were enough for this assessment.
